Show less Read more Like 13 Dislike Reply 1 reply Hide replies 1 reply @zrod1012 2 months ago What if the “& cattle” part was to connect the yellow stone spin offs or a connection to the 6’s Show less Read more Like 6 Dislike ❤ by @BrainPilot Reply @Philip-0 2 months ago (edited) Tommy is due at least two I-told-you-so moments versus Cami, and both of them may play out. The obvious one is the offshore well being a $400m dry hole. The less obvious one is where Gallino aggressively forecloses on a bankrupt M-Tex as he said to Tommy that he would, leaving Cami with nearly nothing. That could bring many more prospects into reach of CTT and Cattle. If law enforcement pressure Tommy for evidence against the Cartel then we might see Gallino's threat against "the one Tommy loves most" become a reality. Perhaps this is why they've spent so much time keeping his wife/daughter front and center.
